name: Red Cape
description: A red cape, for women only. It looks very warm.

name: Animal Fossil
description: The fossil of an animal from thousands of years ago.

name: Plant Fossil
description: The fossil of a leaf of a plant from thousands and thousands of years ago.

name: Winston's Recommendation
description: A letter of recommendation from Winston the Archeologist. Need to deliver this to Dr. Betty of Ellinia.

name: Fossil Box
description: A wooden box that contains fossils. The cover on the box reads: WARNING: Handle with CARE.

name: Plant Sample
description: A plant that's been dug out and preserved with everything still intact.

name: Stuffed Drake Skull
description: A Drake Skull, preserved in its original state with chemicals.

name: Fossil Report
description: Dr. Betty's final report on her study of fossils.

name: Stump's Teardrop
description: Very rarely found from a Dark Axe Stump. A Stump's hardened liquid.

name: Ayan's Toy Sword
description: A toy sword that Ayan played with growing up.

name: Ayan's Letter
description: A letter from Ayan. Must be delivered to Bruce of Henesys.

name: Alligator Skin Pouch
description: A pouch made out of alligator skin. Looks sturdy enough to hold on to most anything.

name: Flying Medicine
description: A fairy medicine that was made with a collection of rare, hard-to-find ingredients. There's a legend, passed from generation to generation, that anyone who takes the medicine can fly, but it's never been confirmed.

name: Strange Mushroom Spore
description: A mushroom spore Arwen the Fairy gave you. Deliver it to Grendel the Really Old for analysis.

name: Glowing Mushroom
description: A mushroom gathered near the strange cave entrance.

name: Lewis's Letter
description: A letter from Lewis in the Free Market. Deliver it to Dances with Balrog in Perion.

name: Dances with Balrog's Letter
description: A letter from Dances with Balrog in Perion. Deliver it to Lewis in the Free Market.

name: Lewis's Letter
description: A letter from Lewis in the Free Market. Deliver it to Chief Stan in Henesys.

name: Chief Stan's Letter
description: A letter from Chief Stan in Henesys. Deliver it to Lewis in the Free Market.

name: Mrs. Ming Ming's Cooking Recipe
description: A recipe that details how to bake Mrs. Ming Ming's special cake.

name: Bruce's Special Cake
description: A special cake that Bruce made for his daughter, Ayan. It looks a bit clumsy, but it gives off a sweet aroma.

name: Vitamin Gummy
description: A sweet gummy packed with healthy vitamins.

name: Special Stirge Phobia Cure
description: A special Stirge phobia cure crafted by Mong from Kong. Eating this will cure Stirge phobia...?

name: Scorched Arcon Scroll
description: A severely burned piece of magical parchment with crumbling, dark edges.

name: Old Chief Stan's Hammer
description: A hammer that Chief Stan lost a very long time ago. It is covered in dirt and debris here and there.

name: Chief Stan's Hammer
description: Chief Stan's hammer. Traces of time remain, but it shines brightly, having been wiped clean.

name: Torn Ledger Pages
description: Torn from a book and used to line a nest. The ink has run in the rain, but a few words are still legible on some of them. Somebody spent a long time writing on these.

name: Incomplete Ledger
description: A registry of adventurers, stamped on the cover by the chief of Henesys. The pages inside are soaked through and mostly unreadable. One word on the top page survived: Warrior.

name: Bound Ledger
description: Rebound in Sleepywood and set properly for the first time in years. Most of the ink has come back. One entry runs the entire length of the book, front to back, and it is the one the rain hit hardest.

name: Smooth Horn Marble
description: A hard marble with a striking pattern. On one corner of the marble, it reads, 'To My Friend Pia.'

name: Torn Note
description: A piece of a note with a hastily scribbled message. The only legible parts seem to be "Deep within Ellinia... ...how to purify the blood of... ...to Chrishrama...".

name: Athena Pierce's Box
description: A box containing a small wooden bow that Athena Pierce used a very long time ago.

name: Broken Wooden Bow
description: A small wooden bow that Athena Pierce used a very long time ago. The bowstring is broken, making it look difficult to use properly.

name: Repaired Wooden Bow
description: A small wooden bow that Athena Pierce used a very long time ago. It's been repaired well and looks ready to use at any time.

name: Alex's Gift Sack
description: A sack containing presents Alex has prepared for the people of Kerning City.

name: A Gift for Nella
description: A present Alex prepared for Nella. What could be inside?

name: A Gift for JM
description: A present Alex prepared for JM From tha Streetz. What could be inside?

name: Halloween Candies
description: Halloween candies acquired from the monsters.

name: Stamped Ledger
description: The long entry names Kerning City and the Dark Lord, though half of it is gone. Whoever kept this book wrote the same person down over and over for years without ever finishing.

name: Encrypted Document
description: A worn document covered in characters that are difficult to make out.

name: Encrypted Document
description: A worn document covered in characters that are difficult to make out.

name: Ink of Truth
description: An ink infused with magical power. It can reveal the hidden truth within an encoded document.

name: Maple Leaf
description: A bright red leaf that drifts down all over Maple World. They say the whole world is named after the tree these fall from.

name: Deciphered Document
description: An envelope containing the deciphered document. Dark Lord must be waiting for this.

name: Amended Ledger
description: A bench by the subway, a pile of gear given away, and a note in handwriting that doesn't match the rest. The oldest part of the entry names the old man at the Ellinia library.

name: Very Dry Branch
description: A dried up branch that has lost all moisture and looks like it will break at the slightest touch.

name: Hearthkeeper's Journal
description: An old journal kept by Elda, a cave fairy hearthkeeper. It is written in the old fairy script.

name: Elda's Name-Charm
description: A small charm carved with Elda's mark. A message is written on the back in the old fairy script.

name: Elda's Last Message
description: Elda's name-charm, wrapped in Daniel the Scholar's written copy of the message on its back.

name: Slime & Mushroom Omok Set
description: A set that allows you to play Omok. Uses slime and mushroom-shaped figures for the game.

name: Slime & Pig Omok Set
description: A set that allows you to play Omok. Uses pig and slime-shaped figures for the game.

name: Slime & Octopus Omok Set
description: A set that allows you to play Omok. Uses slime and octopus-shaped figures for the game.

name: Pig & Mushroom Omok Set
description: A set that allows you to play Omok. Uses pig and mushroom-shaped figures for the game.

name: Octopus & Mushroom Omok Set
description: A set that allows you to play Omok. Uses octopus and mushroom-shaped figures for the game.

name: Pig & Octopus Omok Set
description: A set that allows you to play Omok. Uses pig and octopus-shaped figures for the game.

name: Set of Match Cards
description: A set that allows you to play Match Cards.

name: One-Handed Weapon Crafting Catalyst
description: When used while crafting a one-handed weapon, there is a chance the item's bonus stats will change.

name: Two-Handed Weapon Crafting Catalyst
description: When used while crafting a two-handed weapon, there is a chance the item's bonus stats will change.

name: Armor Crafting Catalyst
description: When used while crafting a armor, there is a chance the item's bonus stats will change.

name: Scroll Crafting Catalyst
description: When used while crafting scrolls, there is a chance to produce an Intermediate, Greater, or Chaos scroll of the same category.

name: The Snail Legend
description: A book that tells of the longest-living Snail in Maple World.

name: Water of Life
description: Mysterious water gathered from the deepest valleys of Ellinia. Use it on a living pet to extend its active time by 30 days, or bring it to Mar the fairy in Ellinia to restore a pet that has turned into a doll, which will also extend its active time by 30 days.
